grunt.name: Grunt
grunt.blurb: Fast and fragile. Comes in numbers.

mender.name: Mender
mender.blurb: Slow and stubborn. Leave it alone for a second and a half and it knits itself whole again.

armoured.name: Armoured
armoured.blurb: Plated and slow. Half of any kinetic hit bounces off.

runner.name: Runner
runner.blurb: Quick and thin-skinned. Gone before a slow gun has turned.

brute.name: Brute
brute.blurb: A wall of meat. Takes its time, and takes a beating.
